title: WhatsApp Business
subtitle: Connect numbers through Meta's official Cloud API, templates and webhook setup
official: Only Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API is used. No unofficial automation.
noAccountsBody: Connect a WhatsApp Business number to receive and send messages from the shared inbox.
mockNotice: Demo mode stores everything locally and sends nothing to WhatsApp. Use it for development and testing only.
tokenMissing: No access token — sending will fail until you add one

hints.accessToken: Stored encrypted and never shown again. A permanent System User token is recommended.
hints.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token
hints.sendRate: Protects against sending too fast (Meta limits by number tier)

noTemplates: No templates. Click sync to pull them from Meta.

webhook.title: Webhook setup in Meta
webhook.body: In the Meta app dashboard → WhatsApp → Configuration, set this callback URL and the verify token configured on the server.
webhook.notConfigured: Not configured — set the environment variable on the server

simulator.title: Inbound message simulator (development)
simulator.body: Sends a real signed webhook to the server — exactly like Meta. Available in demo mode only.
simulator.name: Sender name
simulator.noSecret: Set META_APP_SECRET on the server to sign simulated webhooks.

tokenRequired: A valid access token is required (at least 20 characters)
mockDisabled: Demo mode is disabled in this environment
simulatorDisabled: The simulator is only available in development
simulatorNoMessage: No sent outbound message in this conversation
ownershipFailed: We couldn't verify that this token controls the number. Check the phone number ID, the WhatsApp Business Account ID and the token's permissions.
